offline_rewrites: Restored original root Earth application and dependencies.
Direct local MP3 sources; 14 album and 2 scene songs; corrected pause/selection/crossfade state.
Real orbital elements replay at archived timestamp; epoch validity retained; snapshot UI and time made explicit.
Original local map mode and complete finite tile pyramid; external terrain available through bounded local cache.
Author UI name is 木头做的猫 and author profile hyperlinks are absent.
Live weather modules preserve original Earth rendering; direct Open-Meteo selected-point queries with independent cache and no-data handling.
Global GFS updates use public Unidata NetCDF; original grid shape and rendering retained. Archived photographic clouds stay labeled; current animation now uses dated NOAA/AOML geostrophic analysis.
Ocean imagery uses NASA GIBS maps and official legends with immutable hash-versioned cache URLs.
PB2002 and Marine Regions reference layers reuse original Cesium globe and layer controls.
NOAA/AOML genuine currents use original OACF decoder, SHA256 verification and source missing-data mask.

validation_conditions.external_http_blocked: True in offline regression mode; false for explicit genuine online-forecast checks. Intentional outage injection separately verifies cache fallback.
validation_conditions.visual_evidence: evidence/*.png; original and local globe/solar screenshots reviewed. Animated scenes are not pixel-identical.
validation_conditions.limitations: Finite coverage. Final new-service online/offline checks and six cold starts had no Console/Page/HTTP errors. A separate full Earth navigation regression was 9/10 because one ERR_INVALID_HTTP_RESPONSE was recorded. Earlier failures remain documented; intermittent transport errors are not claimed eliminated. Music handoff can cancel old audio requests.

local_server.runtime_dependencies: Python 3.9+ standard library; modern WebGL browser

known_limits: Original local surface pyramid stops at level 4; extreme zoom does not fetch online imagery.
Source maps and webmanifest/sitemap probes returned HTML fallback.
Source and music credit links require internet when opened.
Weather is a model forecast, not in-situ observation. New data needs network; offline point caches cover only previously requested coordinates.
Global forecast updates require bundled server.py. Standard static hosting retains archived global data and direct online point queries.
Open-Meteo free public endpoint is for non-commercial use with published request limits and CC BY 4.0 attribution.
Monsoon diagnostics and global night airglow remain unavailable: discovered products do not directly support the original globe layers. No simulated substitute is presented as real-time data.
NOAA/AOML current animation uses satellite-derived geostrophic flow only, with publication lag and masked missing/polar cells; excludes tides and total surface currents.
Ocean satellite layers are dated analyses/composites, not instant measurements; 1024x512 maps and 4096x2048 EEZ maps have finite zoom detail.
Photographic cloud imagery remains archived and orbital positions remain historical snapshot replay.

Terrain is a published DEM loaded through a fixed-source proxy and a bounded 128 MB cache; offline missing tiles fall back to the ellipsoid. Detailed elevation does not improve original ground imagery resolution.
HYCOM NCSS was excluded because robots.txt disallows automated data access; its probe data are not bundled.
